scope.environment: Linux Electron 44.9.3 production bundle; current-source isolated QA profile; offline; no wallet/device connected.

method: All thirteen actual PNGs viewed through three local 2x3 contact sheets; MCP, Electrum URL, updater preferences and Early Access originals also inspected at native size. No UI/browser/TUE/app actions or source screenshot/manifest edits.

interpretation: Every assigned feature entry is visible in its corresponding PNG; no additive association erratum is required.
Preferences/entry points do not establish completed actions, hardware connection, OS integration or network operation.
The empty Electrum URL field is present; disabled Add new reflects the source empty/invalid-input condition, not missing functionality.
Offline updater UI with an explicit QA launch override is not evidence of live update availability or a production download.
Unmapped surrounding controls remain visible context; this QC does not invent new observation links for them.
